description: Covers US clinicians by name or specialty, hospital and nursing home ratings, and recruiting clinical trials by condition and location. Clinician records give credentials and practice details. The registry does not rate clinicians or confirm insurance coverage.

country.description: Country when the city is ambiguous

kind.description: clinician (doctor, nurse practitioner, therapist and others), hospital, nursing_home or trial; clinician when a name or specialty is sent

name.description: Part of a hospital's or nursing home's name, to check one place

offset.description: Start a clinician page at this result offset

place.description: City and state, ZIP code, or country for trials

query.description: Name, specialty, condition or a question such as 'dentist in London'

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code instead of city and state

name: check_care
title: Care: clinicians, hospitals, trials
